newsitem.title: UK: BMW to report improved profits - paper.
newsitem.headline: BMW to report improved profits - paper.

text.p: German carmaker BMW expects to announce improved profits for 1996 despite continuing heavy losses at its British Rover subsidiary, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
BMW chairman Bernd Pischetsrieder declined to give a profits forecast but told the newspaper that group earnings in 1996 would be above the 692 million marks ($440.4 million) made after tax in 1995.
Pischetsrieder said Rover would lose less in sterling terms than in 1995.
He said sterling's recent rise against the mark would not affect Rover's results significantly but criticised the British government's opt-out policy on a common European currency. ($1=1.5711 Mark)
